title: GIMMICK: Globally Inclusive Multimodal Multitask Cultural Knowledge Benchmarking
findings: Models perform significantly better on tangible cultural aspects (e.g., food) than on intangible ones. Closed models achieved accuracies of only 8% and 10% for questions concerning rituals or festivals, compared to 30% for food-related questions, highlighting a struggle with nuanced, often religious-related, cultural knowledge, particularly in non-Western contexts.
